pred_sql: SELECT HADM_ID FROM DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE SUBJECT_ID = 10027445 AND DISCHTIME > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

question: Can you identify seasonal trends in medication prescriptions using anomaly detection methods?
pred_sql: WITH MonthlyPrescriptions AS ( SELECT P.DRUG, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM D.ADMITTIME) AS PrescMonth, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM D.ADMITTIME) AS PrescYear, COUNT(*) AS PrescriptionCount FROM PRESCRIPTIONS P JOIN DEMOGRAPHIC D ON P.SUBJECT_ID = D.SUBJECT_ID AND P.HADM_ID = D.HADM_ID GROUP BY P.DRUG, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM D.ADMITTIME), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM D.ADMITTIME) ) SELECT Drug, PrescYear, PrescMonth, PrescriptionCount, AVG(PrescriptionCount) OVER (PARTITION BY Drug, PrescMonth) AS AvgMonthlyCount, PrescriptionCount - AVG(PrescriptionCount) OVER (PARTITION BY Drug, PrescMonth) AS CountDiff FROM MonthlyPrescriptions ORDER BY Abs(CountDiff) DESC;

question: Build a dashboard to track real-time ICU utilization rates and patient demographics.
pred_sql: SELECT D.SUBJECT_ID, D.NAME, D.AGE, D.GENDER, D.ETHNICITY, D.INSURANCE, P.ICUSTAY_ID, COUNT(*) AS ICU_UTILIZATION_COUNT FROM DEMOGRAPHIC D JOIN PRESCRIPTIONS P ON D.SUBJECT_ID = P.SUBJECT_ID AND D.HADM_ID = P.HADM_ID WHERE P.ICUSTAY_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY P.ICUSTAY_ID, D.SUBJECT_ID, D.NAME, D.AGE, D.GENDER, D.ETHNICITY, D.INSURANCE;

question: What is the nationality of patient 10002428?
pred_sql: SELECT ETHNICITY FROM DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE SUBJECT_ID = 10002428;

question: List the diagnoses patient 10016742 received in a different department.
pred_sql: SELECT D.HADM_ID, D.LONG_TITLE FROM DEMOGRAPHIC DM JOIN DIAGNOSES D ON DM.SUBJECT_ID = D.SUBJECT_ID AND DM.HADM_ID = D.HADM_ID WHERE DM.SUBJECT_ID = 10016742 GROUP BY D.HADM_ID, D.LONG_TITLE;

question: Was patient 10000032 put on ventilation during their first ICU stay?
pred_sql: SELECT p.HADM_ID, p.ICD9_CODE, p.SHORT_TITLE FROM PROCEDURES p WHERE p.SUBJECT_ID = 10000032 AND p.ICUSTAY_ID IS NOT NULL AND p.ICD9_CODE IN ( SELECT ICUSTAY_ID FROM ( SELECT D.HADM_ID, MIN(D.ADMITTIME) AS FIRST_ADMITTIME FROM DEMOGRAPHIC D WHERE D.SUBJECT_ID = 10000032 GROUP BY D.HADM_ID ) AS FIRST_ICU_STAY ) AND p.ICD9_CODE LIKE '96.01';

template: How long did {procedure_name} take for patient {patient_id}?
question: What was the duration of the other diagnostic procedures on lung or bronchus for patient 10020306?
pred_sql: SELECT D.DAYS_STAY FROM DEMOGRAPHIC D JOIN PROCEDURES P ON D.SUBJECT_ID = P.SUBJECT_ID AND D.HADM_ID = P.HADM_ID WHERE D.SUBJECT_ID = '10020306' AND (P.SHORT_TITLE LIKE '%lung%' OR P.LONG_TITLE LIKE '%lung%' OR P.SHORT_TITLE LIKE '%bronchus%' OR P.LONG_TITLE LIKE '%bronchus%');

question: Can you detect anomalies in the lab test results of patient 10001217 over time using machine learning techniques?
pred_sql: SELECT D.*, L.* FROM DEMOGRAPHIC D INNER JOIN LAB L ON D.SUBJECT_ID = L.SUBJECT_ID WHERE D.SUBJECT_ID = 10001217 ORDER BY L.CHARTTIME;

question: Can you cluster patients based on their medication patterns?
pred_sql: SELECT SUBJECT_ID, STRING_AGG(DRUG, ', ') AS medication_pattern FROM PRESCRIPTIONS GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID;

question: What percentile is the value of 13.0 in anion gap among patients of the same age as this patient on the first hospital encounter?
pred_sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT L.VALUE_UNIT FROM LAB L INNER JOIN ( SELECT D.SUBJECT_ID, D.AGE FROM DEMOGRAPHIC D INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, MIN(ADMITTIME) AS FIRST_ADMITTIME FROM DEMOGRAPHIC GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID ) AS FHE ON D.SUBJECT_ID = FHE.SUBJECT_ID AND D.ADMITTIME = FHE.FIRST_ADMITTIME WHERE D.AGE = (SELECT AGE FROM DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE SUBJECT_ID = <specific_patient_id> AND ADMITTIME = (SELECT MIN(ADMITTIME) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE SUBJECT_ID = <specific_patient_id>)) ) AS SAME_AGE ON L.SUBJECT_ID = SAME_AGE.SUBJECT_ID WHERE L.LABEL = 'Anion Gap' ))) AS PERCENTILE FROM ( SELECT L.VALUE_UNIT FROM LAB L INNER JOIN ( SELECT D.SUBJECT_ID, D.AGE FROM DEMOGRAPHIC D INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, MIN(ADMITTIME) AS FIRST_ADMITTIME FROM DEMOGRAPHIC GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID ) AS FHE ON D.SUBJECT_ID = FHE.SUBJECT_ID AND D.ADMITTIME = FHE.FIRST_ADMITTIME WHERE D.AGE = (SELECT AGE FROM DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE SUBJECT_ID = <specific_patient_id> AND ADMITTIME = (SELECT MIN(ADMITTIME) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE SUBJECT_ID = <specific_patient_id>)) ) AS SAME_AGE ON L.SUBJECT_ID = SAME_AGE.SUBJECT_ID WHERE L.LABEL = 'Anion Gap' AND CAST(L.VALUE_UNIT AS REAL) <= 13.0 )

question: Which are the top three most frequent procedures patients had within a significant period after being diagnosed with personal history of malignant neoplasm of large intestine since 1 year ago?

question: What are the most common diagnoses among patients with enough follow-up records since 2100?
pred_sql: WITH eligible_patients AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID FROM DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE ADMITYEAR >= 2100 GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID HAVING COUNT(HADM_ID) >= 2 ), relevant_hadm AS ( SELECT d.SUBJECT_ID, d.HADM_ID FROM DEMOGRAPHIC d WHERE d.SUBJECT_ID IN (SELECT SUBJECT_ID FROM eligible_patients) AND d.ADMITYEAR >= 2100 ) SELECT d.ICD9_CODE, d.SHORT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count FROM relevant_hadm rh JOIN DIAGNOSES d ON rh.SUBJECT_ID = d.SUBJECT_ID AND rh.HADM_ID = d.HADM_ID GROUP BY d.ICD9_CODE, d.SHORT_TITLE ORDER BY diagnosis_count DESC;
